rites.name: Zephizis
rites.text: Zephizis is the concept of a sounding that Bronurneld makes as its first roots condense out of the dark, a tone heard by the orders that tend the flame-temples of the Holy Age. It is not a being but a pattern of resonance that the temples learned to read and copy.

rites.name: Veneilinys
rites.text: Veneilinys is a concept of Bronurneld, the first sounding of roots condensing into the world during the Singing, an undated time when outsiders came to anchor and trade. It is remembered as the pattern by which strangers first bound their goods to the ground.

rites.name: Maunteornia
rites.text: Maunteornia is a concept of Bronurneld, the notion of a sworn oath bound into stone at the courts of divine trial. It is said to hold the doors between worlds shut through the Holy Age of flame and temples.

rites.name: Corasia
rites.text: A close strike that shoves an opponent backward and leaves them briefly dazed. Hordes of lesser foes can be held off with it, and captured allies can be freed from certain grasping creatures, though one heavy charger shrugs it off.

rites.name: Amirnus
rites.text: Amirnus is a quiet convergence in Bronurneld that occurs when the three possible futures briefly overlap and the ending splits into branches. Its only surviving trace is a shelf of the Library where every outcome is catalogued in dust-bound ledgers.
